messages:
Alex CSM: Drafting a short runbook for mid-market ramp handoff — prefill + batching + streaming checklist. Sharing for quick review.
Jamie Eng: LGTM overall. One Q: what prefill TTL are you thinking? :thinking_face: 
Alex CSM: Thinking 30m default, with aggressive 5m for high-risk renewal accounts. Then backoff to 2h once steady.
Noah PM: Define high-risk signals so SRE can automate. I'd say >=3 failed renewal outreach attempts or >20% drop in usage week-over-week.
Lin SRE: For high-risk, prefer warm-pools + sticky routing. TTLs above ok but we need a burst_capacity flag in route config and a circuit-breaker if cost spike.
Alex CSM: Agreed. Draft config snippet:
```
prefill:
  default_ttl: 1800  # seconds (30m)
  high_risk_ttl: 300  # seconds (5m)
  backoff_ttl: 7200   # seconds (2h)
  thresholds:
    renewal_signal_count: 3
    usage_drop_pct: 20
```
Emily CS: Add a short customer-facing note for the kickoff: two bullets — what we do and how it helps. I'll draft.
Emily CS: Template for kickoff email:
```
Hi {name},

We’ll prefill and keep a warm pool during your launch window to ensure low latency and a smooth ramp.
We’ll monitor performance and scale down automatically after the window.
If you'd like to adjust the window or budget cap, reply and we’ll schedule.

Thanks,
Alex and CS Team
```
Devon Eng: For implementation, gate behind feature flag `cs.prefill.ramp_v1` and emit metric `console.prefill_cost` + `console.prefill_latency_p50/p90`. Add alert if spend > budget_delta within 1h.
Onboard-bot: Reminder: add a post-launch feedback capture 72h check-in (CS template + one-click survey link).
Maya CS: I'll add the survey link and a short feedback form: 3 Qs — latency OK?; quality OK?; any unexpected errors? plus an optional text field.
Jamie Eng: One more: include a curl sample for customers to trigger client-side prefill (useful for partners doing staged load tests):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/prefill \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tenant_id":"T123","prefill_seconds":600,"reason":"launch-window"}'
```
Alex CSM: Nice. Action items: Emily finalize email, Maya add survey + link, Lin add route flag + alert, Jamie add metrics dashboard, Devon wire up feature flag gating. I’ll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to triage. Thanks all :rocket:
root_message: Alex CSM: Drafting a short runbook for mid-market ramp handoff — prefill + batching + streaming checklist. Sharing for quick review.
